Prayagraj • Since our devotion began

From Shree Bade Hanuman Ji Temple Marg, Bandhwa, we serve food, health and hope to everyone who comes to us — day and night.

Sarva Samarpit Sewa Sansthan is committed to serving, empowering, and transforming lives through education, food, healthcare, and social welfare. From free education and food distribution to medical awareness, plantation drives, sanitary pad distribution, marriage support for needy families, and winter blanket distribution, we work to bring hope and dignity to underprivileged communities.

About us

A trust rooted in faith, devoted to education and human welfare.

Sarva Samarpit Sewa Sansthan is a registered charitable trust headquartered at Shree Bade Hanuman Ji Temple Marg, Bandhwa. Committed to eradicating illiteracy through free education and providing food, warm clothing, and care for every soul in need.

Our Mission

Empowering children through free education and ensuring no one near the Sangam sleeps hungry.

Our Vision

A compassionate, educated society where selfless seva is a universal way of life.

Our work

Four streams of seva

Guided by education as our primary charitable pillar, sustained by community volunteers.

प्राथमिक सेवा
Primary Mission

Free Education (निःशुल्क शिक्षा)

School books, stationery kits, uniforms, and free evening tutoring pathshalas for underprivileged and rural children.

Akhand Seva

Food Distribution (अन्न सेवा)

Freshly cooked hot meals and dry ration for pilgrims, the elderly and families in need around the Sangam and Hanuman Mandir.

Relief Outreach

Clothing & Relief (वस्त्र दान)

Support for the impoverished, widows and the elderly — warm blankets in winter, seasonal clothing and medical assistance.

Ecological Seva

Tree Plantation (वृक्षारोपण)

Plantation of Peepal, Banyan and Neem saplings along the holy Ganga-Yamuna riverbanks, ghat cleanliness and water conservation.

Volunteer

Give your time. Receive blessings.

Help in the kitchen, at medical camps, during Magh Mela and Kumbh, or with outreach. Any skill, any hour.

Sacred Roots at Triveni Sangam

Prayagraj is the king of all pilgrimage centers (तीर्थराज प्रयाग), where the sacred streams of Ganga, Yamuna, and the subterranean Saraswati converge. It is in this consecrated soil, under the eternal vigil of the reclining deity Shree Bade Hanuman Ji Maharaj, that Sarva Samarpit Sewa Sansthan was conceived.

Founded with the sole mandate of selfless service without caste, creed, or regional bias, the Sansthan operates on the cardinal Vedic truth: "नर सेवा ही नारायण सेवा" (Service to mankind is the purest worship of the Divine). During the auspicious Magh Mela and Mahakumbh, as well as every single ordinary day of the year, our volunteers serve warm meals, potable water, medical first aid, and shelter to pilgrims walking barefoot to the sangam.

• Akhand Bhandara • Sadhu Seva • Pilgrim Assistance • Ganga Aarti Support
ॐ

Ethos: Selfless Dedication (आत्मार्पण)

Unlike conventional bureaucracies, Sarva Samarpit Sewa Sansthan is powered by genuine field volunteers, devout youth, and respected elders who give their time, energy, and resources freely. We believe that true philanthropy is not merely financial charity; it is standing beside a helpless child in a slum, feeding a saint in winter, and nursing a distressed soul with deep familial compassion.

✓

Zero Admin Bloat: 100% of public donations directly fund food, uniforms, books, medical kits, and ground relief.

✓

Unbroken Continuity: 24 hours a day, 365 days a year without a single pause since foundation.

✓

Direct Accountability: Every single donation verified with computer-generated receipts and tax-exemption certificates.

Guiding Principles • मार्गदर्शक सिद्धांत

Our Mission & Vision

“Service for every person, dignity in every life, and progress for every community.”

Our Sacred Pledge

Our Mission

“To empower every section of society through service, education, and values, and to build a healthy, educated, self-reliant, and compassionate society.”

Rooted at Shree Bade Hanuman Ji Temple, Sangam Marg, Prayagraj, our mission is to eliminate poverty-driven illiteracy, food insecurity, and social deprivation through unceasing selfless service.

Our Long-Term Horizon

Our Vision

“To work towards a Hunger-Free and Educated India by ensuring access to food, education, and essential support for every individual in need.”

We envision an India where no child is deprived of education, no family sleeps hungry near sacred pilgrimages, and seva is embraced by every citizen as a timeless duty.

Core Strategic Pillars

Our Key Focus Areas (प्रमुख कार्यक्षेत्र)

The fundamental seven dimensions through which Sarva Samarpit Sewa Sansthan creates enduring ground-level impact:

Education & Knowledge

Free evening pathshalas, distribution of school kits, stationery, uniforms, and moral values coaching for slum and village children.

Service & Support for Needy

24-hour Akhand Annapurna Langar at Shree Bade Hanuman Ji Temple, warm winter blankets, clothing drives, and disaster relief.

Healthcare & Welfare

Regular free medical awareness camps, diagnostic checkups, doctor consultations, and distribution of essential medicines.

Women & Child Empowerment

Sanitary pad distribution drives, menstrual hygiene education, nutritional support for mothers, and self-defense & skill training.

Environmental Protection

Mass tree plantation drives along the Sangam banks and rural belts, river cleaning, plastic awareness, and water conservation.

Social Harmony & Humanity

Promoting universal brotherhood (“Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam”), inter-community solidarity, and marriage support for needy families.

Nation Building (राष्ट्र निर्माण)

Fostering active citizenship, patriotic youth leadership, cultural heritage preservation, and selfless dedication to building a developed, self-reliant India (Atmanirbhar Bharat).

Message from the Founder

Sewa As The Highest Form of Worship

“Sewa is the highest form of worship. When we serve people, we serve the divine.”

Dear Devotees, Well-Wishers, and Volunteers,

When you stand on the banks of Triveni Sangam, where the holy Ganga, Yamuna, and mystical Saraswati merge, you experience the timeless pulse of Bharat. Here, millions arrive in search of spiritual peace. Yet, among them are also those shivering in winter nights without a blanket, those who have traveled hundreds of miles on empty stomachs, and elderly pilgrims unable to afford basic medicines.

It was from this sacred realization that Sarva Samarpit Sewa Sansthan took birth. Our mission is pure: to be the hands that feed, the medicine that cures, and the warmth that consoles.

I invite each one of you to join hands with us. May the blessings of Shree Bade Hanuman Ji protect and inspire you and your family.

Pt. Harsh Tiwari (पं. हर्ष तिवारी)

Founder & Chief Managing Trustee

Sarva Samarpit Sewa Sansthan, Prayagraj

🌳 "हमारा संकल्प - भूखमुक्त, शिक्षायुक्त एवं हरित भारत"

प्रकृति का संरक्षण ही मानव जीवन की सच्ची सेवा है

सर्व समर्पित सेवा संस्थान द्वारा अन्न व विद्यादान के साथ-साथ प्रकृति एवं पर्यावरण संरक्षण हेतु 'हरित धरा पौधारोपण महाअभियान' निरंतर संचालित किया जाता है। ग्रामीण अंचलों, सार्वजनिक स्थलों, विद्यालयों व जलाशयों के समीप फलदार (आम, अमरूद, जामुन) तथा प्राणवायु प्रदाता वृक्षों (नीम, पीपल, बरगद) का बड़े पैमाने पर रोपण किया जाता है। इसके साथ ही शीतकाल में संगम तट, रैन बसेरों व ग्रामीण बस्तियों में जरूरतमंदों को गर्म कंबल व वस्त्र वितरण की सेवा की जाती है।

🌳 सघन पौधारोपण अभियान फलदार व छायादार पौधों का नियमित रोपण व देखरेख

तीर्थराज प्रयागराज में संगम किनारे स्थित श्री बड़े हनुमान जी का मंदिर संपूर्ण विश्व में अद्वितीय है। मंगलवार और शनिवार तथा हनुमान जयंती जैसे विशेष उत्सवों पर लाखों श्रद्धालु दर्शन हेतु आते हैं। हमारे स्वयंसेवक भारी भीड़ को नियंत्रित करने, बुजुर्ग श्रद्धालुओं को सहारा देने, खोया-पाया केंद्र संचालित करने और निरंतर महाप्रसाद वितरण में सहयोग करते हैं।

Privacy Policy (गोपनीयता नीति)

Last updated: October 2026 • Sarva Samarpit Sewa Sansthan (Registered Public Charitable Trust)

1. Organization Identity

This Privacy Policy governs the manner in which Sarva Samarpit Sewa Sansthan (Registration: UP/2018/0192847), located at Shree Bade Hanuman Ji Temple, Sangam Marg, Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh - 211005, collects, uses, maintains, and protects user information collected through sarvasamarpitsewasansthan.com.

2. Information We Collect

We collect personal identification information from users and donors solely when voluntarily submitted:

  • Personal Details: Full Name, Mobile / WhatsApp Number, and Email Address.
  • Statutory Tax Exemption (80G): Permanent Account Number (PAN Card) is collected exclusively to issue valid 80G digital donation receipts and report Form 10BD to the Income Tax Department of India.
  • Volunteer / Sevadar Registration: Identity credentials, photograph, address, and seva preference.

3. Payment & Financial Security

All online financial transactions are processed securely through RBI-licensed payment aggregators, including Razorpay, with 256-Bit SSL/TLS military-grade bank encryption. We do NOT collect, store, or process donors' credit/debit card numbers, CVVs, or Net Banking PINs on our servers.

4. Use of Collected Data

The information collected is strictly utilized for:

  • Dispatching official Section 80G tax exemption donation receipts and Form 10BD certificates.
  • Issuing verified digital Sevadar/Volunteer Identity Cards.
  • Communicating updates regarding Akhand Annapurna Langar, free evening pathshalas, and charitable seva programs.
  • Strict adherence to statutory regulatory requirements under Indian Law.

5. Data Protection & Non-Disclosure

We strictly enforce a Zero-Sale Policy. We do not sell, trade, rent, or lease donor personal data to third parties. Data is protected pursuant to the provisions of the Information Technology Act, 2000 and the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023.

6. Grievance Officer & Contact

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact our compliance desk:
Trust Secretary / Compliance Officer: Sarva Samarpit Sewa Sansthan
Shree Bade Hanuman Ji Temple, Sangam Marg, Prayagraj, UP - 211005
Phone: 09450858514 • Email: contact@sarvasamarpitsewasansthan.com

Trust Governance • नियम एवं शर्तें

Terms & Conditions (नियम एवं शर्तें)

Guidelines and operating terms of Sarva Samarpit Sewa Sansthan • Registered Indian Charitable Trust

1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing or donating on sarvasamarpitsewasansthan.com, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms and Conditions and all applicable laws of the Republic of India.

2. Nature of Charitable Contributions

Sarva Samarpit Sewa Sansthan is an officially registered non-profit charitable trust. All donations made via UPI QR, Net Banking, Debit/Credit Cards, or Razorpay are non-commercial voluntary contributions dedicated towards:

  • 24-Hour Akhand Annapurna Langar at Shree Bade Hanuman Ji Temple, Prayagraj.
  • Free evening pathshalas, books, uniforms, and educational supplies for underprivileged students.
  • Medical awareness, free health checkups, and sanitary hygiene kits.
  • Winter blanket distribution, tree plantation, and marriage assistance for needy families.

3. Tax Exemption & Section 80G Certificates

Donations are eligible for tax deductions under Section 80G of the Income Tax Act, 1961. Donors providing a valid Indian PAN will receive an authentic digital 80G receipt, which is electronically reconciled in Annual Form 10BD filing with the Income Tax Department.

4. Digital Identity & Volunteer Badges

Official digital ID cards generated via our portal are issued exclusively to registered volunteers, trustees, and executive members. Misuse, forgery, or unauthorized solicitation using our digital ID is strictly prohibited and subject to legal prosecution.

5. Governing Law & Jurisdiction

These terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India. Any disputes arising out of or related to these terms shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh.

Fair Transactions • दान वापसी नीति

Donation Refund Policy (दान वापसी नीति)

Transparency and guidelines regarding donation cancellations and payment reconciliations

1. Voluntary Nature of Charitable Donations

As a registered public charitable trust, donations made to Sarva Samarpit Sewa Sansthan are voluntary contributions deployed directly for daily langar food supplies, emergency medical relief, and student coaching. Consequently, once a donation is completed, refunds are generally not entertained.

2. Accidental or Duplicate Transactions

In rare cases where an inadvertent error occurs during payment processing, our trust will review refund requests under the following conditions:

  • Duplicate Debits: If a donor's bank account was debited more than once for a single donation attempt due to network timeout or gateway lag.
  • Erroneous Amount: If an unintended amount was entered due to a typographical error.
  • Reporting Window: The refund request must be made in writing within 7 calendar days of the transaction date.

3. Refund Request Procedure

To request an investigation and refund of a duplicate or erroneous contribution, please email our finance team with the following details:

  • Donor Name, Phone Number, and Email Address
  • Date and Time of Transaction
  • Razorpay Payment ID / Bank Transaction Reference / UTR Number
  • Proof of deduction (bank statement screenshot or SMS receipt)

Send request to: contact@sarvasamarpitsewasansthan.com or WhatsApp: 09450858514.

4. Processing & Settlement Timeline

Upon receipt and audit verification by our accounts desk, approved refunds will be processed through the original payment gateway (Razorpay) and credited back to the originating bank account or card within 5 to 7 working days.
